<!--
Thanks for testing JHT. A reproducible account of what happened is useful.
Just answer what feels relevant — leave the rest blank. No need
to be technical to file this.
-->

## What did you try to do?

<!-- Looking for a job in a specific field? Testing the setup? Trying the dashboard? -->

## What happened?

<!-- What did you actually see or experience? -->

## What did you expect to happen instead?

<!-- The mismatch between expectation and reality is what we learn from. -->

## How did you install JHT?

- [ ] Native Godot desktop app
- [ ] CLI one-liner (`curl ... | bash`)
- [ ] Source clone
- [ ] Other:

## How long did the setup take you?

<!-- Approximately. Five minutes? An hour? Helps us improve onboarding. -->

## What would have helped?

<!-- A clearer step, a missing button, a translation, a friendlier error
message, a missing explanation — anything. -->

## Screenshots or recordings (optional)

<!--
Only attach material that is safe for a public repository. Crop or redact
names, email addresses, CV/application content, machine addresses, hostnames,
account identifiers and tokens. Never upload a raw database, configuration
file or credential store.
-->

## Anything else?

<!-- Free text. Tell us anything we didn't ask. -->

Triage SLA: a label within ~48h (see docs/internal/ops/triage.md).
You don't need to file a bug report separately — if we spot a bug
inside your feedback, we'll tag and track it.
